known_limitations: The matrix is intentionally read-only and records only explicit service dependency fields from authoritative artifacts; it does not infer hidden dependencies from prose, names, or command proximity.
Providers are attached only when their service field exactly matches a catalog service id or service name; unmatched provider service labels are reported as warnings.
Runtime JSON output is generated locally at runtime/services/service_dependency_matrix.json and is not committed when runtime outputs are ignored by repository policy.
pull_request_url is null until the PR is created.
summary: Implemented a read-only Estate Service Dependency Matrix built on the service catalog, with explicit service dependency mapping, exact provider matching, startup sequencing, failure-impact reporting, source artifact links, warnings for incomplete metadata, CLI access, generated Markdown output, and tests for dependency mapping, graceful incomplete metadata handling, startup ordering, and source-link integrity.
